outcome: Produce a controller-validated six-file research package that assesses the complete mechanical-error prevention system against the fixed eight properties and six measurable success conditions.
why_repeatable: The research playbook completeness workflow is reused whenever a system-wide implementation goal must be grounded through core research, three hardening lenses, adjudication, and planner-ready package emission.
inputs: Frozen prevention-system charter and atomic requirements.

steps.result: The complete objective and atomic requirements are frozen without narrowing or expansion.
steps.note: No research agent starts before controller validation succeeds.

steps.result: A fresh assessment-only core researcher returns a structured candidate covering every frozen requirement.
steps.note: The parent owns all writes and agent lifecycle evidence.

steps.result: The candidate and common envelope are schema-validated and hash-bound.
steps.note: Reject missing requirement coverage before lens execution.

steps.result: Three fresh independent lenses return exact terminal envelopes for readiness, coverage, and satisfaction.
steps.note: Run concurrently with no cross-lens visibility.

steps.result: All lens envelopes and closed lifecycle evidence are recorded against one candidate and envelope hash.
steps.note: Every declared material gap must be explicitly surfaced for adjudication.

steps.result: A fresh independent adjudicator classifies every raw finding without editing the candidate.
steps.note: Only FIX_IN_RESEARCH findings may cause parent research edits.

steps.result: Deduplicated dispositions and terminal research verdict are controller-recorded.
steps.note: Any candidate edit triggers a fresh complete round.

steps.result: Exactly six planner-ready files are emitted and validated with zero active agent slots.
steps.note: PASS requires all eight properties and six measures to have grounded implementation and verification obligations.

failure_handling: Stop on scope mutation, malformed agent output, controller rejection, missing accessible evidence, budget rejection, or slot leakage; catalog the blocker before retry and permit at most one retry per role within the shared caps.
verified_path: Controller-valid PASS package; all three lenses PASS on the same hashes; fresh adjudicator has no research-actionable finding; every planner obligation is READY; all agent slots are closed.
